column3: 130.    Where  under  the  provisions  of  this  Chapter  an
employer is required to record or furnish particulars in such
form  and  in  such  manner  as  may  be  specified  by  the
Commissioner-General, it shall be sufficient compliance with
those provisions if the particulars are recorded or furnished
by the employer in such form and in such manner as may be
approved in writing by the Commissioner-General, upon an

column2: application in that behalf made by the employer.
